summary: Extend the existing atomic drawing-identifier guard to explicit Detail callouts and keep them workflow-scoped.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Detail callouts are drawing references and fit the existing bounded drawing-identifier guard
An offline reproduction proved that numeric-component validation accepted a detail recombined from two cited callouts
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes deterministic answer-accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only explicitly labelled Detail forms with a bounded digit-bearing identifier are interpreted.
Unlabelled callouts and arbitrary drawing prose do not support a Detail claim.
The guard does not inspect geometry or determine applicability, discipline, revision, contractual authority or precedence.
